note: libphext-smalltalk: Pharo 12 (files.pharo.org get-files/120, VM reports Pharo v10.3.13) installed user-level on aletheia-core at ~/telephone-smalltalk/pharo12, no sudo. Implementation in src/phext.st (PhextLib buffer API + DynPhext CLRS quarter-full dynamic array + TrnPhext nested-map transitive store), src/json.st (own JSON parser + canonical writer), src/telephone.st (stateless CLI + in-image suite). 0.6.1 parity, remove coordinate-preserving (explicitly tested). The CLI runs per invocation from the PRISTINE image with the three sources filed in by ~/telephone-smalltalk/run.st (~0.5 s per call): images saved from a command-line session silently ignore later command-line handlers in this Pharo build, so no pre-saved image is used. Suite green on hub: 35 checks; fixtures 16/16 byte-identical round-trips, normalize idempotent. Adapter contract v2 self-test PASS. Smoke-001 one-shot verify verbatim {"first_failure": null, "impl": "smalltalk", "placements_checked": 30, "verdict": "pass"}. Game scale on a snapshot of live test-001 (1017 placements, 2351603 bytes, sha256 09e6c6b8...), two runs: serve init 0.06-0.09 s (deferred cache), choose 8.32 s -> 4.4.4/4.4.4/4.7.4 (first run measured 49.67 s under heavy multi-wave hub contention; second run is the steady state, inside the 15 s turn window), apply 8.69-11.42 s (sha match), driver-form validate 6.61-7.34 s PASS. Pharo quirks handled: filed-in sources bind classes to script temporaries (this Pharo compiles a script file as one unit, so textual references to just-created classes fail); the chunk-format reader treats '!' as a chunk terminator, so sources contain no '!' (the verify failure message reads 'index lines differ from placements'); FileStream binaryWriteStream does not truncate an existing file, so the CLI deletes the response file before writing (a stale tail otherwise leaks into the next serve response); method parameters are read-only; the VM does not exit after an st script unless the script ends with snapshot:false andQuit:true. PGP via subprocess gpg (LibC system:), GNUPGHOME ~/telephone-smalltalk/gnupg, UID telephone-smalltalk, ed25519; SHA-256 and base64 are image builtins (SHA256, ZnBase64Encoder).
